title: Naengmyeon with Korean-Style Noodle Sauce
description: A refreshing summer dish from Korea, featuring buckwheat or starch noodles served with a spicy sauce and various toppings.

ingredients.name: yummy sauce (gochujang, soy sauce, vinegar, sugar, garlic, ginger)

instructions: Cook the naengmyeon noodles according to the package instructions.
In a blender, combine yummy sauce ingredients and blend until smooth.
Heat the blended sauce in a pan over medium heat.
Add Korean chili flakes and stir to combine.
Add soy sauce, rice vinegar, and sugar, and stir to combine.
Add garlic and ginger, and stir to combine.
Taste and adjust the seasoning as needed.
Serve the noodles with the spicy sauce and your choice of toppings.
